user.title: Nilan CTS 602 (MQTT)
user.description: The nilan-mqtt reader must be running (version 1.2.0 or newer) and connected to the same MQTT broker as Home Assistant. Enter the MQTT topic set on the reader's page.

confirm.title: Add {name}?
confirm.description:
Reader nilan-mqtt {version} on topic `{topic}` offers {entities} entities.

Entities of this reader that Home Assistant already has through MQTT discovery: **{found}**. Taking them over keeps their entity ids, history, statistics and your settings (names, areas, display precision); the reader's own discovery is switched off. Without taking over you get every entity twice.

data.takeover: Take over the existing MQTT entities

error.mqtt_unavailable: Home Assistant's MQTT integration is not set up or not connected.
error.no_meta: Nothing found on this topic. Is the reader running, version 1.2.0 or newer, and is the topic right?
error.newer_protocol: The reader is newer than this integration understands. Update the integration.

abort.already_configured: This reader is already set up.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The message found is not from a nilan-mqtt reader.
abort.newer_protocol: The reader is newer than this integration understands. Update the integration.

data.silence_minutes: Minutes without values before a warning under Repairs

reader_offline.title: {name}: the nilan-mqtt reader is not running
reader_offline.description: Nothing has come from the reader on `{topic}` for {minutes} minutes: the program is stopped, the computer it runs on is off, or it lost the MQTT broker. Check the service (`systemctl status nilan-mqtt`) and the reader's page. The warning disappears when values come again.

unit_silent.title: {name}: the Nilan does not answer the reader
unit_silent.description: The reader on `{topic}` runs but has not had an answer from the Nilan for {minutes} minutes. Check the RS485 adapter and cable, and the Modbus settings on the reader's page. The warning disappears when values come again.
